label: Sec. 01 Intro
title: Open money and open intelligence
money: Bitcoin is money you can hold and send yourself. No company issues it or can take it back. It can work for everyday payments between people, or as money that moves across borders without a platform in the middle. These are related, not identical. Spiral funds design and experience work so more people can actually use it.
intelligence: Most AI tools take your files and your process in exchange for access. Open intelligence keeps the model and the results on machines you or your group control. It can also make it possible to train models of your own, using data you choose, rather than leaving that capability only to large companies. You can keep working if a service changes or shuts down.
brief: Spiral is looking for people with bold ideas and the motivation to work on open money, open intelligence, or both. You can focus on one. You can also look for ways the two meet. The work lays ground for systems that are not hidden — systems where people can see and shape how money moves and how tools run, instead of handing both to platforms that build data centers, profiles, and payment layers to keep control.
support: We support you throughout the process with guidance, feedback, and strategic input to help shape a strong and well-developed proposal. Spiral reviews proposals and funds selected projects.
